Prevents leaking node IP addresses when unconfirmed wallet transactions are periodically resent.
reviewability: Waiting on author to rebase and respond to an open objection.

Users relying on private broadcast keep that protection when transactions are rebroadcast.

why: P2 because wallet rebroadcast logic stops bypassing the user privacy configuration.
